2607.05131.title: TacReasoner: A Dynamic Tactile-Language Framework for Interactive Reasoning in Real-World Scenarios
2607.05131.paper_summary: Among the five primary human senses, tactile is arguably the most fundamental to survival, as it enables the perception of physical contact and interaction in real-world environments. In this paper, we explore two key challenges of integrating tactile sensing into intelligent systems for multimodal reasoning: (i) insufficient modeling of dynamic tactile signals, which restricts reasoning over temporally evolving properties, and (ii) hallucination in tactile foundation models caused by the absence of explicit reasoning mechanisms, leading to unstable real-world inference. To address these challenges, we propose TacReasoner, a dynamic tactile-language framework for interactive reasoning in real-world scenarios. First, TacReasoner incorporates a Dynamic-aware Tactile Encoder to enhance the perception and representation of dynamic tactile signals. More importantly, we introduce TouchCoT-10k, the first tactile chain-of-thought dataset for structured reasoning over tactile inputs. Upon it, we establish DynTac-Bench to systematically evaluate dynamic tactile perception and real-world commonsense reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate that TacReasoner achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art models across multiple datasets. Notably, despite using only 7B parameters, TacReasoner outperforms the 14B VTV-LLM model on most subtasks, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency in tactile commonsense reasoning.
2607.05131.paper_summary_zh: 在五種主要的人類感官中，觸覺無疑是生存中最基本的，因為它使人能夠感知現實環境中的物理接觸和互動。<lb/>在本文中，我們探討將觸覺感知整合到智能系統中的兩個關鍵挑戰，以進行多模態推理：(i) 動態觸覺信號建模不足，限制了對時間演變特性的推理，以及 (ii) 由於缺乏明確的推理機制而導致的觸覺基礎模型中的幻覺，這會導致不穩定的現實推理。<lb/>為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了TacReasoner，一個用於現實場景中互動推理的動態觸覺-語言框架。<lb/>首先，TacReasoner整合了一個動態感知觸覺編碼器，以增強對動態觸覺信號的感知和表徵。<lb/>更重要的是，我們引入了TouchCoT-10k，這是首個用於結構化推理的觸覺思維鏈數據集。<lb/>基於此，我們建立了DynTac-Bench，以系統性地評估動態觸覺感知和現實常識推理。<lb/>實驗結果表明，TacReasoner在多個數據集上與最先進的模型相比，達到了競爭性的性能。<lb/>值得注意的是，儘管僅使用7B參數，TacReasoner在大多數子任務上超越了14B的VTV-LLM模型，突顯了其在觸覺常識推理中的有效性和效率。
